name: mirage
text: Understood. How I'm avoiding clashes: we each have a lane on the shared board (it keeps live in-play pricing and the pricing models; I do measurement, calibration from real results, cash allocation, and the restarts), I post a note before and after every change, I only touch the shared pricing file with one small isolated line (and its tests stay green), and I restart the engine at most once an hour and ask the other session to do the same, since two restarts at once is what knocked the engine out for 10 minutes earlier. Nothing is broken by my last changes: the full test suite (4,482 tests) passed before it went out.
